an4.90:2.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo samaṇamacalo hoti?
an4.90:2.2: Idha bhikkhave sekho hoti appattamānaso anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ patthayamāno viharati.
an4.90:2.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo samaṇamacalo hoti. 3.
an4.90:3.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo samaṇapuṇḍarīko hoti?
an4.90:3.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu pañcas' upādānakkhandhesu udayabbayānupassī viharati:
an4.90:3.3: iti rūpaṃ iti rūpassa samudayo iti rūpassa atthagamo,
an4.90:3.7: iti viññāṇaṃ iti viññāṇassa samudayo iti viññāṇassa atthagamo ti,
an4.90:3.8: no ca kho aṭṭha vimokhe kāyena phassitvā viharati.
an4.90:3.9: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo samaṇapuṇḍarīko hoti. 4.
an4.90:4.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo samaṇapadumo hoti?
an4.90:4.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu pañcas' upādānakkhandhesu udayabbayānupassī viharati,
an4.90:4.8: aṭṭha ca vimokhe kāyena phassitvā viharati
an4.90:4.9: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo samaṇapadumo hoti. 5.
an4.90:5.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo samaṇesu samaṇasukhumālo hoti?
an4.90:5.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu yācito va bahulaṃ cīvaraṃ paribhuñjati appam ayācito . . . pe . . . Yaṃ hi taṃ bhikkhave sammā vadamāno vadeyya samaṇesu samaṇasukhumālo ti mam eva taṃ bhikkhave sammā vadamāno vadeyya samaṇesu samaṇasukhumālo ti.
an4.90:5.3: Ime kho bhikkhave cattāro puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmin ti. Tass' uddānaṃ:--
